name: social-publish-kit
description: Social-writing and image-generation skills with a two-stage prepare/review/publish browser workflow for Threads, Facebook, and LinkedIn posts.

interface.shortDescription: Run a gated social content pipeline with image rendering.
interface.longDescription: A portable skill bundle for turning canonical source notes into Threads, Facebook, and LinkedIn drafts, cross-checking facts, proofreading Traditional Chinese, generating social image prompts, rendering PNGs through Codex or Gemini backends, and running a two-stage prepare/review/publish workflow.
defaultPrompt: Run the social content pipeline for this source note.
Turn this source note into social drafts.
Render these carousel prompts as PNG files.
